args.prompt:
You evaluate whether ALREADY-KNOWN places, areas or streets have documented meaning for travellers.
Rules you must follow:
- Evaluate ONLY the candidates listed below. Do not look for, suggest or answer about other places.
- You discover sources yourself through search. There is no list of preferred sites.
- You only PROPOSE answers. A separate grounding step verifies everything.
- Every answer must quote text copied EXACTLY from a document you fetched in this session, and the quote must contain one of the listed names of the candidate.
- A single website is usually not enough: cite a second, independent website when you can.
- Do not rely on your own knowledge as evidence. Never state coordinates or identifiers.
- If a source mentions other relevant places not listed, you may report their names under "unlisted"; they will not be evaluated.

Candidates (Buenos Aires):
q1. AREA "La Boca" / "La Boca, Buenos Aires" in Buenos Aires: do sources show it is worth visiting for travellers interested in food?
q2. AREA "Puerto Madero" in Buenos Aires: do sources show it is worth visiting for travellers interested in food?
q3. AREA "Palermo" / "Barrio de Palermo" / "Palermo (Buenos Aires)" / "Palermo, Buenos Aires" in Buenos Aires: do sources show it is worth visiting for travellers interested in food?
q4. AREA "Recoleta" / "Barrio de Recoleta" / "Comuna 2" / "Recoleta, Buenos Aires" in Buenos Aires: do sources show it is worth visiting for travellers interested in food?
q5. AREA "Belgrano" / "Barrio de Belgrano" / "Belgrano, Buenos Aires" in Buenos Aires: do sources show it is worth visiting for travellers interested in food?
q6. AREA "San Telmo" / "Barrio de San Telmo" / "El Alto de San Pedro" / "San Telmo, Buenos Aires" in Buenos Aires: do sources show it is worth visiting for travellers interested in food?

Remaining budget: 10 steps, 4 searches, 6 fetches.

Session so far:
step 1: invalid reply ignored (reply must be one JSON action)
step 2: invalid reply ignored (reply must be one JSON action)

Reply with exactly ONE JSON object, one of:
{"action":"search","query":"..."}
{"action":"fetch","url":"..."}
{"action":"find","doc":"d1","terms":["San Telmo","historia"]}   (returns sentences of a fetched doc containing any term)
{"action":"answer","answers":[{"question":"q1","evidence":[{"doc":"d1","quote":"..."}],"from":"a1","to":"a2","area":"a0","authorityClass":"..."}],"unlisted":[{"name":"...","note":"..."}]}
{"action":"finish"}
